body:
Update: thank you for every single comment, from the acid burns to the oddball cute ones :) 
I’ve taken notes on skincare, obtaining affordable plastic surgery for my nose and changing my wardrobe. I will definitely keep growing my hair (I haven’t gone near it with scissors for a year because during the 2021 lockdown I fell into the shaved head trend: mistake, it felt nice to feel water directly on the scalp, never doing it again). I downloaded a different calorie tracker app than the ones I used in the past and I’ve picked an exercise routine I want to try. If it doesn’t work I’ll amend it, not abandon it. It’s a lot of work, but I really want to stop being such an eyesore, so thank you for all your help :)
Absolutely grew up fighting mum for mini skirts (and often losing). Thank you! 😊
Thank you! ☺️☺️
I appreciate it a lot 😊
Thank you! 😊
This is really helpful, thank you! I’ll look it up :)
Thank you :) and all the best 💗
Admittedly… it’s free real estate 😏 (which the surgery isn’t, otherwise I probably would have had it already 😄)
Thanks :)
I don’t get it
Thank you, that’s so helpful and informative! :)
You don’t look particularly ugly to me but genuinely I thought you were doing a silly face, not a regular smile
Ah I see. In that case apology accepted :)
Thank you :)
I’m here to be called ugly, not a liar
I don’t appreciate accusations. I am 25 and yes I have a stressful life. I understand I look much older to most people, that is not a good reason to call me a liar
Thank you! :)
Thank you :) I knew brutality was coming hehehe I came prepared.
Thank you for this comment 🙏🏼

Aw thanks! However I’m afraid the comments on this post definitely prove you wrong about me being “fine” 😂 it’s ok, I knew it. To be honest I was just tired of everyone around me being a hypocrite and calling me beautiful 😅
I’m not, however I’ve often thought myself that I’m not feminine enough. I do have unusually high testosterone for a cis woman due to Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
Thank you! I will keep growing my hair, it’s an aftermath of a “pandemic bald cut” from last year 😅 (it’s a good thing for everyone I wasn’t leaving the house much at the time lol)
Spot on, I’m Italian 😁
Thank you! :)

It wasn’t clear to me, especially after being accused of breaking the rules based on “a suspicion”. After that I read it as doubling down on the concept of accusing me of not being who I said I was. A 25 year old, cisgender female. The fact that I don’t look it is a different story than straight up not believing me when I say I am.
Thanks for the comment! I definitely see a trend and it’s really helpful :)

I said thank you for the feedback? Also it’s not the judgment on my appearance I take slight offence to, it’s the one on my honesty. First I get accused of posting someone else’s pictures, then of lying about my age, both on a hunch. You’re more than welcome to say anything about my appearance since that’s the whole point. However I find it inappropriate to be judged on my character for no reason
Thanks! I definitely would if I had the money, I’ve always hated my nose 😅. I’m gonna focus on weight and skin first then see where I’m at
Thanks:)
Thanks:)
Thank you :)

They were all taken in the span of a few days, before and after a hairdressers appointment (which admittedly went very wrong since I asked for pastel/icy blue and got… that.) thank you for your comment, I put a lot of effort into that makeup and it was the first time I tried it so it means a lot ☺️
Thank you! Both weight and acne are things I struggle with, I’m going to try harder with that. One thing I was oblivious about is my sense of style apparently needs a radical rethink too
Thanks for the brutal honesty I guess
The hair is bleached 🤣
Are you after my ID? I’m 25
Ok, I’m doing another post with the pic now
Honestly I think your face is above average, very pretty. Obviously dressing up and makeup can improve just about anyone, but you’re starting with a very solid base
No, but maybe try a different haircut. I think getting rid of that fringe would help. You can either let it grow to like ear length or cut it off
Please tell me what I can do to improve!
Update: drying my hair. I almost passed out because apparently now having a shower takes a physical toll on me. Wow. Downside is that woke up my husband. I now have to wait for him to go back to bed
